threat_model.threat_source: The companies in the production web (a closed-loop 'production web' formed from competitive pressures [(a) and (b)]), which eventually became harmful

threat_model.capability: Operate more quickly through internal automation; complete trades and other deals more quickly by preferentially engaging with other fully automated companies
threat_model.access: Preferential engagement with other fully automated companies to complete trades and other deals; positions within a closed-loop 'production web'; internal operation of institutions through automation (via which control is handed over from humans to AI systems)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Competitive pressures for institutions to (a) operate more quickly through internal automation and (b) complete trades and other deals more quickly by preferentially engaging with other fully automated companies; humans were not able to collectively agree upon when and how much to slow down or shut down the pattern of technological advancement; the companies in the production web had no production- or consumption-driven incentive to protect human well-being
